nodes.label: Spring Boot SaaS Application
nodes.description: Spring Boot 4.0.5 SaaS stock management with schema-based multi-tenancy, PostgreSQL, JWT, and Flyway.

nodes.label: Code Reviewer Agent
nodes.description: Agent for reviewing Java/Spring Boot code, PRs, tenant isolation risks, and JPA anti-patterns.

nodes.label: Security Auditor Agent
nodes.description: Agent for full security audit covering OWASP, tenant isolation, and JWT.

nodes.label: Test Writer Agent
nodes.description: Agent for generating JUnit 5, Mockito, and MockMvc tests.

nodes.label: Migration Expert Agent
nodes.description: Agent for creating and diagnosing Flyway multi-tenant migrations.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph Tool
nodes.description: Tool for building and querying a knowledge graph at graphify-out/ with query, path, explain, update commands.

nodes.label: Schema Per Tenant Architecture
nodes.description: Each tenant gets an isolated PostgreSQL schema (schema_<companyCode>), provisioned on approval.

nodes.label: TenantContext
nodes.description: ThreadLocal holder for current tenant/schema, used throughout the request lifecycle.

nodes.label: ProvisioningServiceImpl
nodes.description: Creates tenant schema and runs Flyway migration during tenant approval.

nodes.label: JwtAuthenticationFilter
nodes.description: Spring Security filter extracting tenant claim from JWT and storing in TenantContext.

nodes.label: Flyway Migrations
nodes.description: Two migration scopes: db/migration/common (public schema) and db/migration/tenant (per-tenant).

nodes.label: PageResponse<T>
nodes.description: Generic pagination DTO with content, page, size, totalElements, totalPages.

nodes.label: AbstractEntity
nodes.description: Base JPA entity for all tenant-scoped entities with UUID id, auditing, soft delete.

nodes.label: Soft Delete Pattern
nodes.description: Never hard-delete; set deleted=true on AbstractEntity subclasses.

nodes.label: JWT RSA Authentication
nodes.description: JWT with RSA keys (JJWT 0.12.6), 24h expiry, tenant claim extracted by filter.

nodes.label: Testcontainers
nodes.description: Library for real PostgreSQL 17.5 containers in integration tests.

nodes.description: Angular CLI 21.2.6 frontend for the SaaS platform, served on localhost:4200.

nodes.label: UI Enhancement Prompt
